patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,29 +1,80 @@
-class Zipper:
-    # Tree is a dict with keys "value" (int), "left" (dict or None), "right" (dict or None)
-    @staticmethod
-    def from_tree(tree: dict) -> "Zipper":
-        pass
-
-    def value(self) -> int:
-        pass
-
-    def set_value(self, value: int) -> "Zipper":
-        pass
-
-    def left(self) -> "Zipper | None":
-        pass
-
-    def set_left(self, tree: dict | None) -> "Zipper":
-        pass
-
-    def right(self) -> "Zipper | None":
-        pass
-
-    def set_right(self, tree: dict | None) -> "Zipper":
-        pass
-
-    def up(self) -> "Zipper | None":
-        pass
-
-    def to_tree(self) -> dict:
-        pass
+class Zipper:
+    def __init__(self, tree, path=[]):
+        self.tree = tree
+        self.path = path
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def from_tree(tree: dict) -> "Zipper":
+        return Zipper(tree)
+
+    def value(self) -> int:
+        return self.tree["value"]
+
+    def set_value(self, value: int) -> "Zipper":
+        new_tree = self._copy_tree(self.tree)
+        new_tree["value"] = value
+        new_zipper = Zipper(new_tree, self.path[:])
+        new_zipper._rebuild_tree()
+        return new_zipper
+
+    def left(self) -> "Zipper | None":
+        if self.tree["left"] is None:
+            return None
+        new_path = self.path + [("left", self.tree)]
+        return Zipper(self.tree["left"], new_path)
+
+    def set_left(self, tree: dict | None) -> "Zipper":
+        new_tree = self._copy_tree(self.tree)
+        new_tree["left"] = tree
+        new_zipper = Zipper(new_tree, self.path[:])
+        new_zipper._rebuild_tree()
+        return new_zipper
+
+    def right(self) -> "Zipper | None":
+        if self.tree["right"] is None:
+            return None
+        new_path = self.path + [("right", self.tree)]
+        return Zipper(self.tree["right"], new_path)
+
+    def set_right(self, tree: dict | None) -> "Zipper":
+        new_tree = self._copy_tree(self.tree)
+        new_tree["right"] = tree
+        new_zipper = Zipper(new_tree, self.path[:])
+        new_zipper._rebuild_tree()
+        return new_zipper
+
+    def up(self) -> "Zipper | None":
+        if not self.path:
+            return None
+        direction, parent = self.path[-1]
+        new_tree = self._copy_tree(parent)
+        new_tree[direction] = self.tree
+        return Zipper(new_tree, self.path[:-1])
+
+    def to_tree(self) -> dict:
+        if not self.path:
+            return self.tree
+        current = self
+        while current.path:
+            current = current.up()
+        return current.tree
+
+    def _copy_tree(self, tree):
+        if tree is None:
+            return None
+        return {
+            "value": tree["value"],
+            "left": self._copy_tree(tree["left"]) if "left" in tree else None,
+            "right": self._copy_tree(tree["right"]) if "right" in tree else None
+        }
+
+    def _rebuild_tree(self):
+        if not self.path:
+            return
+        current = self
+        for direction, parent in reversed(self.path):
+            parent_copy = self._copy_tree(parent)
+            parent_copy[direction] = current.tree
+            current = Zipper(parent_copy, [])
+        self.tree = current.tree
+        self.path = []
